name: upstream-task-rename
title: task.py has no rename, so renaming a task is a four-place hand edit that breaks parent and child links
description: Renaming a Trellis task means git mv plus hand-editing task.json id, name, and title and the prd.md H1. Parent and child links store directory names, so a rename silently dangles every reference to the task.
creator: sdelmas
